purpose: Every artifact an executing build reports or publishes is built (strict scheduler-result indexing, --nobuild fallback only): an aspect's artifact of an output group its base target shares, and a test's runfiles without links or manifests.
genuine_key_findings: build --aspects=//pkg:defs.bzl%extra_aspect --output_groups=extra //pkg:t (the aspect adds to the 'extra' group //pkg:t already has): exit 0, 'Target //pkg:t up-to-date: bazel-bin/pkg/t.base' AND 'Aspect //pkg:defs.bzl%extra_aspect of //pkg:t up-to-date: bazel-bin/pkg/t.aspect', both files written, '3 total actions' (t.base, t.aspect, workspace status).
The same with --nobuild: exit 0, 0 total actions, nothing written, no up-to-date lines.

test --nobuild_runfile_links //pkg:dt and test --nobuild_runfile_manifests --output_groups=default //pkg:dt: exit 0, the test (which cats its generated data runfile) passes; data.txt is built in both (the test action consumes the runfiles tree, TestActionBuilder.java:255-257).
native_before: fe93cc1^ (strict results[id] indexing, no --nobuild): all three executing cases panic 'no entry found for key' (the aspect's t.aspect action, the unbuilt runfiles tree and the unbuilt data runfile were pruned, yet reported/published).

fe93cc1 (results.get fallback also when executing): the aspect case executes 1 action and reports the never-built planned path 'bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/pkg/t.aspect' as up-to-date; the tests fall back to planned paths.
known_divergences: Native summary line is its own format ('bazel-rs: N actions executed, ...'); native does not count the workspace status action (genuine '3 total actions' vs native '2 actions executed').
Under --nobuild native still reports the planned paths (stdout 'LABEL\tPATH' and the stderr aspect report) where genuine prints no up-to-date lines (pre-existing, see reference_receipt.json).
